id: title:DanielVisca:drop replayed duplicate points behind a flag

observations.behavior: Adds a feature flag and its associated deduplication parameter to the query runner.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog users or operators to opt into removing exact duplicate metric points caused by Kafka replay without changing other behavior.

observations.behavior: Implements ClickHouse LIMIT BY using series fingerprint and point fields to keep only one row per unique combination of those values.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides deterministic de-duplication at database level for metrics queries when enabled, reducing redundant rows while preserving distinct measurements.

observations.behavior: Adds tests covering both single-batch and multi-batch scenarios including explicit replayed-with-dedupe cases and same-time different-value edge case.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that deduplication does not remove legitimate changes between batches but removes exact copies; also checks last-value aggregation skips cost. This could help prevent incorrect totals if duplicates were retained.

observations.limitations: The implementation is gated behind an internal-only feature flag with no release notes or adoption indicators. The benefit depends on whether a production incident involving double-counting has occurred, which cannot be established from this patch alone. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction demonstrated across components.

review.limitations: The implementation is gated behind an internal-only feature flag with no release notes or adoption indicators. The benefit depends on whether a production incident involving double-counting has occurred, which cannot be established from this patch alone. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction demonstrated across components.
review.reason: This chunk adds bounded capability and correctness improvement by introducing opt-in deduplication of metric points caused by Kafka re-play. It includes relevant parameter passing, query construction, helper functions, and regression-style unit tests. However, the change remains localised within the backend query runner and its samples module without broader architectural dependency or cross-component propagation. Tier 3 requires demonstration of materially broader capability or systemic risk reduction across critical paths, which is absent here. Tier 1 would apply only to narrow maintenance or documentation; this introduces new behavior and test coverage, warranting at least Tier 2.
review.posthog_relevance: Could reduce redundant rows in ClickHouse queries for metrics ingestion and reporting when duplicate events are replayed. Relevant primarily to warehouse and managed warehouse connectors and users relying on accurate event-based aggregations. Not adopted or released as indicated; relevance remains potential rather than realized.
review.uncertainty: The actual runtime impact and user benefit depend on external factors not shown: frequency of Kafka replays, existing production incidents, and whether the feature flag will be enabled broadly. The patch does not establish adoption or incident avoidance.
